note: Planned task-to-evidence mapping. A listed path is not itself a pass; final assessment inspects current evidence and reports unfinished gates.

tasks.title: Refresh the authorized execution baseline
acceptance_criteria: The exact plan revision, TRD digest, root identity, execution authority and source/destination boundary are recorded.
The baseline records unrelated edits, existing Task/TRD/plan history, product files and watcher state; absent services are not installed.

tasks.title: Specify the canonical record and path contracts
acceptance_criteria: Contracts describe all required record/config fields, invalid states and explicit null origin values without invented Task IDs.
Canonical MEMORY/, adopted reference-assets/MEMORY-depo contracts, reusable source ownership and generated/recovery path classes are unambiguous.

tasks.title: Specify scoped publication and recovery
acceptance_criteria: Director and confirmed manager grants are checked against actual current scope; a child can produce only a proposal.
Journal recovery defines every interrupted commit boundary, preserves originals/reasons and cannot repair memory by replaying Task state.

tasks.title: Freeze the local backend pilot specification
acceptance_criteria: The profile names exact package pins, model identity and immutable model/package artifacts, local config/project binding and disabled automatic updates/frontmatter rewriting.
The specification names the adapter entry points to test, license source, local resource measurements and a provisioning authority boundary; no cloud route or global installation is planned.

tasks.title: Define the requirement-driven acceptance fixtures
acceptance_criteria: All 59 requirements have planned evidence and explicit negative cases; native and real backend observations are separate from deterministic tests.
Expected relevance uses known fixture evidence, preserves all mandatory checks and adds no unsupported numerical performance target.

tasks.title: Implement record and configuration validation
acceptance_criteria: All five record types and non-Task origins validate; malformed identifiers, unsupported YAML/schema/type/state and unresolved required values fail without writes.
Skill metadata, dispatch and documented defaults form a complete installable package; example records are clearly non-active.

tasks.title: Implement project and corpus confinement
acceptance_criteria: Two projects, nested Projects paths, hardlink/alias cases and credential paths cannot cross accepted read/write boundaries.
Default README/docs/research patterns and all excluded directories apply equally during ingestion and query result filtering.

tasks.title: Implement evidence and applicability checks
acceptance_criteria: Unsupported implementation claims, false origin IDs and unexplained source mismatches cannot become unqualified active records.
Accepted designs, observed failures, cancelled work and historical handoffs retain distinct claim types and limitations.

tasks.title: Implement strict inspection operations
acceptance_criteria: Inspections preserve governed bytes and mtimes even with absent config, missing database and stale indexes.
No import/startup path initializes a backend, changes a Task/role or downloads packages/models; unsupported capabilities are disclosed.

tasks.title: Implement proposals and atomic publication
acceptance_criteria: Only an authorized current publisher activates a reviewed evidence-backed record; proposals remain outside shared active recall.
Competing/human/stale writes return explicit conflicts and preserve the existing note and unrelated records.

tasks.title: Implement lifecycle transactions and correction recovery
acceptance_criteria: Every multi-record interruption reports actual committed records and resolves without duplicate identity, missing reason or silent half-supersession.
Recovery touches only its memory operation; optional capture repair cannot reopen or replay a Task, and correction cannot silently destroy historical records.

tasks.title: Implement classified maintenance boundaries
acceptance_criteria: Only declared rebuildable products can be replaced/removed; unknown or sole-copy durable state blocks cleanup.
Maintenance never touches .sys4ai/template-update or role-transition recovery and never runs as an inspection side effect.

tasks.title: Verify core publication and preservation
acceptance_criteria: Core acceptance cases pass with precise expected results and current source hashes; every failure remains classified.
Read-only routes work in an unprovisioned environment and historical Task/role/source bytes remain unchanged.

tasks.title: Implement deterministic Markdown and exact-term retrieval
acceptance_criteria: Known identifiers, paths, errors and labels find the expected permitted records with deterministic tie-breaking.
Historical records require an explicit historical request, and lexical fallback creates no index or backend state.

tasks.title: Implement TeX evidence extraction
acceptance_criteria: Representative theorem/proof/equation fixtures preserve literal expressions and identifiers.
Retrieved passages resolve to the original source digest and section/label rather than a generated conclusion.

tasks.title: Implement PDF extraction with explicit limits
acceptance_criteria: Text results retain source pages and digest; scans, difficult equations/tables/layouts are flagged for supported richer or visual inspection.
PDF dependency ownership is explicit; missing extraction support neither installs packages nor breaks Task/role or direct Markdown reads.

tasks.title: Implement attributable HTML extraction
acceptance_criteria: Substantive fixture content is retrievable with source location/version and heading context.
Original bytes remain unchanged and presentation/navigation material does not dominate matches.

tasks.title: Bind normalization and related representations
acceptance_criteria: Changed inputs make derived products visibly stale until authorized rebuild; read-only lookup does not regenerate them.
Known TeX/PDF companions do not count as independent supporting evidence; similarly named unrelated files remain separate.

tasks.title: Verify retrieval and source fidelity
acceptance_criteria: Every exact query returns its expected permitted source and usable provenance, with explicit coverage/limitations for unavailable formats.
Canonical sources and read-only state remain unchanged; normalized evidence never activates a note automatically.

tasks.title: Integrate immutable Task memory packets
acceptance_criteria: Packet and referenced evidence conform to existing project-relative {path, sha256} refs, safe regular files, the 250000-byte per-file bound and the 200-entry evidence-list bound.
The same immutable packet and canonical baseline reach every initial solver, including queued solvers, without a new Task schema field/event.

tasks.title: Enforce frozen recall and sibling exclusions
acceptance_criteria: Publishing or editing another note cannot silently change one solver input; every permitted extra source is attributable to the assignment version.
Contaminated full-history forks are rejected or replaced through an observed supported isolation route, never by an instruction to ignore drafts.

tasks.title: Integrate memory changes and publication receipts
acceptance_criteria: Material memory changes invalidate affected current gates and reconcile running writers before rebinding; immaterial edits have an explicit assessment.
Actual memory receipts can be linked through permitted Task artifacts/files without invented state, replayed events, terminal reopen or automatic task selection.

tasks.title: Update reusable Task and role guidance
acceptance_criteria: Guidance preserves fresh Roles pair selection, real manager activation/sole writer, exact settings, independent identities and complete generic/complex/extra-complex teams.
Read-only startup and Task routes do not create/close/upgrade anything; generic Template policy remains separate from depot intake/age closure.

tasks.title: Verify Task compatibility and context contracts
acceptance_criteria: Schema-1 fixture bytes survive inspections/reruns and unsupported memory_state/promotion fields remain rejected.
Deterministic packet, publisher, context and category checks pass without changing existing Task schema or importing memory into Task/role inspectors.

tasks.title: Implement the Basic Memory projection
acceptance_criteria: Projection preserves custom provenance/chronology in retrievable mappings and canonical byte hashes remain unchanged.
Excluded/sibling/non-active material is filtered before backend indexing and rechecked when results are resolved.

tasks.title: Implement the guarded local query adapter
acceptance_criteria: Public reads expose no arbitrary backend writer/project/config command, startup sync, package/model download or cloud route.
Result provenance and actual lexical/vector/hybrid mode are explicit, and frozen packet constraints apply after backend ranking.

tasks.title: Implement explicit backend maintenance
acceptance_criteria: Indexing is separately invoked and never runs inside public inspection or new-project setup.
The maintenance receipt records version/config/projection and actual effects; canonical notes/Tasks/roles are unchanged and recovery data remains attributable.

tasks.title: Verify adapter boundaries without provisioning
acceptance_criteria: All deterministic boundary tests pass with no backend installation or network dependency.
The report explicitly reserves actual backend isolation, resources, search and filesystem behavior for the live pilot.

tasks.title: Finish reusable documentation and starter definitions
acceptance_criteria: The reusable package is complete and examples cannot become active shared recall; Template identity remains unspecialized and backend disabled.
Canonical memory/config are trackable while exact disposable runtime paths are documented; unrelated recovery and protected source content remain visible.

tasks.title: Define complete Template memory mappings
acceptance_criteria: MEMORY-depo/starter/MEMORY/README.md maps to Template MEMORY/README.md and starter/memory.yaml maps to Template memory.yaml.
Complete skill and contract assets have one identified destination; no learned memory, backend data or product adoption enters the mapping.

tasks.title: Implement memory-aware initializer edition
acceptance_criteria: New-edition creation selects the full empty capability and a stable distinct identity with local relative contract paths and backend disabled.

Earlier editions retain original required skills, role layouts and v4 license obligations; prepare-existing/rerun preserves note/config bytes and records copied/specialized/preserved assets factually.

tasks.title: Verify initializer editions and preservation
acceptance_criteria: New fixtures have distinct identity and no learned/absolute backend data; existing memory/config and v1-v4 semantics remain intact.
All interrupted stage reruns account for actual copied, specialized, preserved and skipped assets without auto-provisioning or real product migration.

tasks.title: Verify Template update safety
acceptance_criteria: Template checks detect missing starter config/README/contracts/skill and any learned records.
Updater operations preserve non-owned bytes and report customized targets/recovery accurately; whole-collection retirement still requires its existing explicit route.

tasks.title: Publish and verify the registered Template
acceptance_criteria: The registered Template contains the complete empty capability and current deterministic mappings without project-specific learned/runtime content.
Post-apply check reports current, no unresolved conflict/pending transaction, and prior unrelated Template files are preserved.

tasks.title: Review the active-root adoption manifest
acceptance_criteria: Each proposed destination has current and desired hashes or a bounded content merge; no blind package overwrite absorbs root-specific behavior.
The root owns its stable sys4ai-depot memory identity and adopted reference-assets/MEMORY-depo contracts; real products and factual registry stay unchanged.

tasks.title: Adopt the reviewed root capability
acceptance_criteria: The active root validates against its own adopted configuration/contracts and the intended installed integrations.
Local Task intake/age closure, histories, To-TRD edits, licenses, product bytes and registry are preserved; no runtime provisioning occurs as an adoption side effect.

tasks.title: Verify the adopted root and retained workflows
acceptance_criteria: Relevant retained suites and installed memory contracts pass, with baseline failures separated from regressions.
Root lexical/direct access works without backend provisioning, and all inspected read-only operations preserve governed bytes/mtimes.

tasks.title: Validate scoped root capture before the pilot
acceptance_criteria: The approved note records an actual observed result and its limits, current evidence/source digests and scoped publisher, without claiming a backend/native pass.
Publication and direct/lexical recall preserve existing notes and allow inspection of supporting evidence.

tasks.title: Provision the explicitly authorized local pilot
acceptance_criteria: Actual package/model artifacts, interpreter, effective project/config/routing and disabled automatic behaviors match the reviewed manifest.
The pilot uses local resources only; ordinary reads/setup trigger no provisioning and no host-wide unrestricted MCP server is registered.

tasks.title: Run isolated backend compatibility scenarios
acceptance_criteria: Every mandatory fixture scenario is actually exercised or explicitly reported as failed/blocked/unexercised with its reason; query relevance and mode are attributable.
The report states exact canonical/source/Task/role byte and mtime preservation, project isolation, exposed writer behavior and actual rebuild/outage effects.

tasks.title: Run the bounded active-root backend pilot
acceptance_criteria: The bounded root context has observed canonical preservation, project isolation, source provenance, mode disclosure, controlled rebuild and outage fallback.
If isolated safety blocks this run, the root result remains explicitly unexercised and semantic use stays disabled; no unsafe scenario is forced on live history.

tasks.title: Measure the pilot operating profile
acceptance_criteria: The report identifies exact software/model versions, license source and local operating requirements without relying on historical rankings or prices.
Resource figures identify measurement method, corpus/context and actual run conditions; unavailable observations are labeled.

tasks.title: Record compatibility and conditional enablement
acceptance_criteria: The decision cites actual checks and tested versions and distinguishes completed evaluation, compatible adoption and enabled root behavior.
Any failed, blocked or incomplete mandatory pilot check leaves semantic use off, preserves lexical/direct reads and remains visible in release evidence.

tasks.title: Exercise native generic memory use
acceptance_criteria: Actual receipts prove current role reads, manager ownership/generation, one generic worker and authorized proposal/publication behavior.
Memory adds no reviewer, senior, separate implementer, Task activation side effect or unverified stopping claim.

tasks.title: Exercise native complex frozen context
acceptance_criteria: Every solver receives the same exact packet/baseline and confirmed model/effort; native inherited context excludes sibling content.
Complex work retains its full solver/senior topology without a mandatory per-candidate reviewer; accepted implementation uses a distinct authorized implementer when applicable.
tasks.verification_method_override: User directed remaining tests without sub-agents; local functional verification is complete and remaining live runs are excluded.

tasks.title: Exercise native extra-complex review gates
acceptance_criteria: The complete required logical team and one-to-one reviewer mapping are preserved through capacity queuing and revision.
Changed candidate/input versions invalidate affected reviews and downstream acceptance; no missing or stale pass is treated as current.
tasks.verification_method_override: User directed remaining tests without sub-agents; local functional verification is complete and remaining live runs are excluded.

tasks.title: Exercise native material-change and recovery gates
acceptance_criteria: Running/uncertain owners are reconciled before material rebinding and current native receipts prove stopping; an immaterial edit has an explicit assessment.
Optional memory retry leaves committed/terminal Task events intact, while a required missing memory deliverable remains unmet.
tasks.verification_method_override: User directed remaining tests without sub-agents; local functional verification is complete and remaining live runs are excluded.

tasks.title: Validate fresh-context root capture and recall
acceptance_criteria: Fresh-context retrieval identifies the actual canonical record, project, source digests and verified meaning without granting historical authority.
The evidence distinguishes direct/lexical, backend, native and end-to-end observations and states any unsupported fresh-context or backend case explicitly.

tasks.title: Verify the integrated change and preservation
acceptance_criteria: Every changed artifact has a requirement/design basis and current verification; all 59 requirement criteria have evidence or an explicit unmet/unexercised classification.
Exact protected paths have affirmative preservation results, updater state is current, prior watcher state is restored and no unselected product or unrelated ledger is changed.

tasks.title: Publish the local release assessment
acceptance_criteria: The report maps REQ-001 through REQ-059 to current evidence and explicit unmet/unexercised outcomes with no silent deferral.
Completion claims match all mandatory gates; a negative pilot remains a negative adoption result, and existing products/Git/deployment/future environments are not declared exercised.
